name: Lost Dog, New Wolf
source:
2005. Midwest Nowheresville.

A lonely girl struggles through life with her only gleam of joy being a long distance girlfriend she has never met.

When the young couple is suddenly thrust together, inexperienced sexual relations become the least of their worries as they prepare to fight against a fiendish shadow from their past.

In a world of people dead set on destroying you, hurting the one you love is a succulent treasure you must defend with your life.

[From [url=https://poundworks.itch.io/lostdognewwolf]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2005年。中西部无处可居。

一个孤独的女孩在生活中挣扎，她唯一的快乐是成为一个从未谋面的远距离女友。

当这对年轻夫妇突然走到一起时，缺乏经验的性关系成为他们最不担心的事情，因为他们准备与过去的恶魔阴影作斗争。

在一个人们一心要毁掉你的世界里，伤害你所爱的人是你必须用生命捍卫的宝贵财富。

[来自[url=https://poundworks.itch.io/lostdognewwolf]itch.io[/url]]
